contentTypes.name: Quiz (Question Set)

contentTypes.name: Multiple Choice
contentTypes.summary: Create flexible multiple-choice questions with single or multiple answers.
contentTypes.description: Standard quiz question type allowing learners to pick one or more options with instant feedback.
